senses.gloss:
अध्रि a. [न-धृ-कि] Not
restrained, irresistible.
--Comp.
--गु-गू a.
[अध्रि-गम्-कू-डिच् ऊङादेशोवा] of
irresistible motion or course (अधृतगमन),
impetuous; यदध्रिगावो अग्निगू इदा चिदह्नो
अश्विना Rv. 8. 22. 11
--(गुः) N. of a
heavenly killer of sacrificial victims, or
the name of the formula itself
ending with an invocation of Agni.
--ज a. [अध्रिं जनयति, जन्-ड] making
irresistible.
--पुष्पलिका the
betelnut plant.

अध्रियमाण a.
1 Not held, not to be
got hold of; not forthcoming.
--2
Not surviving, dead.

अध्रुव a.
1 Uncertain, doubtful.
--2
Unsteady, moving, not fixed or
permanent; स्वांगेऽध्रुवे P. III. 4. 54;
separable (which can be severed or
detached without fatal or disastrous
effects) (येन विना न जीवनं सो ऽध्रुवः Sk.)
--वं An uncertainty; यो ध्रुवाणि
परित्यज्य अध्रुवाणि निषेवते । ध्रुवाणि तस्य
नश्यंति अध्रुवं नष्टमेव च; cf. the English
phrase ‘A bird in the hand is worth
two in the bush.’

अध्रुषः Quinsy; a kind of disease
attended with fever arising from the
affection of blood; शोथः
स्थूलस्तोददाहप्रकाशो रक्ताज्ज्ञेयः सोऽध्रुषो रुग्ज्वराढ्यः Suśr.

आध्र a. Ved. [आ-धृ-क] Poor,
indigent, weak.
--ध्रः Support.
